source.name: GeoNames AU postal extract and 12 reviewed Q3 SILO reference points

boundary.source: ABS ASGS2021 WA state land polygon

geography.rule: Exact (postcode, locality.casefold) join to pinned server-side public registry; no fuzzy matching or client coordinate authority. This registry currently has one locality per postcode.
geography.newAreaIncome: null unless independently source-verified; no inferred SAL/POA crosswalk

snapshot: Latest supplied actual usage date; active requires opening evidence, no closure on/before cutoff, and row at cutoff. Missing evidence is unknown. Counts unchanged across forecast months.
retainedSchema: Existing normalised q3-area-context plus optional notOpenAtSnapshotAccounts. Raw source headers unchanged.
stage: Aggregate-only response; 30 minute lifetime; explicit replace requires stageId/baseGeneration.
largeFixtureNote: Sparse quarterly observed daily rows are sufficient for the current Q3 account-as-of calculation. Explicitly label sparse coverage. They are individual observations, never monthly totals relabelled as daily. Full dense50k two-yearhistory requires a separate streamingextension. Header/row/requestboundsstillapply.
